title: Shipping Share in Northgate Marketplace Not-As-Described Claims
content:
**Shipping allocation notice — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** The shipping portion added to the amount claimed for an item not as described depends on the seller program and on the shipping charged: on a Freight Seller order that was charged shipping, it is the order's shipping charge divided by the order's units times the requested units still unrefunded; on an order of any other seller program that was charged shipping, it is the order's shipping charge times the price paid for the requested units still unrefunded divided by the order's merchandise total; where no shipping was charged there is no shipping portion.

**Worked figures (hypothetical orders).**

| Order | Shipping charged | Order units | Price paid for the units | Merchandise total | Shipping portion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, 2 units | 90.00 | 6 | not used | not used | 90.00 divided by 6 times 2, that is 30.00 |
| any other seller program, units priced 100.00 | 12.00 | not used | 100.00 | 400.00 | 12.00 times 100.00 divided by 400.00, that is 3.00 |
| any program, free shipping | 0.00 | any | any | any | none |

The Freight Seller share is by piece, so two units of very different value carry the same share; every other program shares the charge by the value of the requested units still unrefunded.
